mapper.select: SELECT m1.*, m2.menu_id as child_menu_id, m2.parent_id as child_parent_id, m2.menu_name as child_menu_name, m2.menu_code as child_menu_code, m2.menu_level as child_menu_level, m2.link_url as child_link_url, m2.sort_num as child_sort_num, m2.status as child_status FROM sys_menu m1 LEFT JOIN sys_menu m2 ON m1.menu_id = m2.parent_id AND m2.is_deleted = 0 WHERE m1.parent_id = 0 AND m1.is_deleted = 0 AND m1.status = 1 ORDER BY m1.sort_num ASC, m2.sort_num ASC
SELECT m.* FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.menu_id = rm.menu_id WHERE rm.role_id = #{roleId} AND m.is_deleted = 0 AND m.status = 1 ORDER BY m.menu_level ASC, m.sort_num ASC
SELECT * FROM sys_menu WHERE menu_id = #{menuId} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM sys_menu WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND status = 1 ORDER BY sort_num ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_menu SET parent_id = #{parentId}, menu_name = #{menuName}, menu_code = #{menuCode}, menu_level = #{menuLevel}, link_url = #{linkUrl}, sort_num = #{sortNum}, status = #{status}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE menu_id = #{menuId} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE sys_menu SET is_deleted = 1, deleted_at = NOW(), updated_by = #{updatedBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE menu_id = #{menuId}
